newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS adds Szczecin to Polish destinations.
newsitem.headline: SAS adds Szczecin to Polish destinations.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) said on Friday that it would start direct flights from the Danish capital to the Polish city of Szczecin on April 28.
"The route will be served five days a week with a Fokker 50 aircraft able to carry 46 passengers," an SAS statement said, adding that flying time would be one hour.
It said that many Scandinavian businesses were located in the Polish port city, SAS' fourth destination in the country.
SAS, jointly owned by the governments of Denmark, Norway and Sweden and private investors, already flies to Warsaw, Gdansk and Poznan.--Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
